dublinCore.dc:rights: Pursuant to Title 17 Section 105 of the United States Code, this file is not subject to copyright protection and is in the public domain.

action.action-desc: Mr. DeFazio (for himself, Mrs. Napolitano, Mr. Young, and Mr. Katko) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure

form.official-title: To amend the Federal Water Pollution Control Act to reauthorize certain water pollution control programs, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Water Quality Protection and Job Creation Act of 2019.

subsection.text: Section 106(a) of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1256(a)) is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking and at the end of paragraph (1);
by striking the semicolon at the end of paragraph (2) and inserting ; and; and
by inserting after paragraph (2) the following:
such sums as may be necessary for each of fiscal years 1991 through 2019, and $300,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2020 through 2024;

subsection.text: Section 106(e) of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1256(e)) is amended by striking Beginning in fiscal year 1974 the and inserting The.

section.text: Section 122(c) of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1274(c)) is amended to read as follows:

subsection.text: There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section $120,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2020 through 2024.

section.header: Pilot program for alternative water source projects

subsection.text: Section 220(d) of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1300(d)) is amended by striking paragraph (2) and redesignating paragraph (3) as paragraph (2).

Section 220 of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1300) is amended by striking subsection (e) and redesignating subsections (f) through (j) as subsections (e) through (i), respectively.

Section 220(h)(1) of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (as redesignated by subsection (b) of this section) is amended by striking or wastewater or by treating wastewater and inserting , wastewater, or stormwater or by treating wastewater or stormwater.

Section 220(i) of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (as redesignated by subsection (b) of this section) is amended by striking a total of $75,000,000 for fiscal years 2002 through 2004 and inserting $75,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2020 through 2024.

section.header: Sewer overflow and stormwater reuse municipal grants
section.text: Section 221(f)(1) of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1301(f)(1)) is amended by striking 2020 and inserting 2024.

section.header: State water pollution control revolving funds
section.text: Title VI of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1381 et seq.) is amended—

paragraph.text: by redesignating section 608 as section 607; and
by adding at the end the following:

section.text: There is authorized to be appropriated to carry out this title $4,000,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2020 through 2024.
